ValidationRule.description: Every payment transaction must include its protected source and idempotency data.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR(ISBLANK(Opportunity__c), ISBLANK(Quote__c), ISNULL(Amount__c), ISBLANK(TEXT(Status__c)), ISBLANK(TEXT(Payment_Provider__c)), ISBLANK(TRIM(Logical_Payment_Key__c)), ISBLANK(TRIM(Idempotency_Key__c)))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Complete all required payment transaction fields.
